_comment: Calendars the date can be shown in. The game clock counts days in the Holocene calendar (holocene year = astronomical year + 10000, so 8801 HE = 1200 BC and 10001 HE = 1 AD); every other calendar is a conversion of it. kind: solar (Gregorian months and leap years, year = astronomical year + year_offset; no year 0) or hijri (the tabular Islamic lunar calendar). era_before: era for years before 1, counted backwards with no year 0 (BC, before the founding of Rome, before the Hijra). requires_flag: the calendar stays disabled until this world flag is set by an event. adopted_by: countries whose main religion is listed use it. default: the calendar used when no other applies.
